gpio_high_v.note: GPIO high outputs are 3.3 V. Inputs are 3.3 V tolerant.

gpio_pin_max_ma.note: Prose limit: an individual GPIO can supply up to 16 mA. The same page's DC table lists IOL minimum 18 mA at VO = 0.4 V and IOH minimum 17 mA at VO = 2.3 V, both footnoted as maximum drive strength (16 mA). Those are different measurements, not a second supply budget.

not_5v_tolerant.note: Applying 5 V to a GPIO can permanently damage the SoC.

vil_max_v.note: BCM2835, BCM2836, BCM2837, and RP3A0 table. The page names Raspberry Pi Zero as an example.

i2c_fixed_pullup_ohm.note: GP2 (SDA) and GP3 (SCL) only. Other pulls are software controlled.

zero_w_typical_active_ma.note: Typical bare-board active current for Zero W. Not a maximum.

supply_v.note: The power page says all models require a 5.1 V supply.

hdmi_typical_ma.note: Row in the general interface table, not a Zero W measurement.

camera_typical_ma.note: Camera Module row in the general interface table.

zero_has_undervoltage_detect.note: Low-voltage detection exists on models since the B+ except the Zero range. The threshold quoted for other models is 4.63 V ±5%.
